cases.title: Neon Alley Chase
cases.summary: A motorcycle courier weaves through a rain-slick neon alley at night, tracked by a low chasing drone shot.
cases.promptFull: A courier on a matte-black motorcycle weaves through a narrow neon-lit alley at night, rain slicking the asphalt into mirrored color. Low chasing drone shot, motion blur on the wheels, steam rising from street vents, camera banking hard on turns, cinematic anamorphic flares.
cases.creator: wenjie_frames

cases.title: Rainy Cafe Monologue
cases.summary: A woman delivers a quiet lip-synced monologue at a window table while rain streaks the glass behind her.
cases.promptFull: Medium close-up of a woman at a cafe window table, delivering a quiet monologue with precise lip-sync to the provided voice track. Rain streaks the glass behind her, warm tungsten interior light against cool blue exterior, shallow depth of field, subtle handheld sway.
cases.creator: littlelens.ai

cases.title: Studio Orbit Sneaker Reveal
cases.summary: A single sneaker rotates on a pedestal under shifting studio light for a clean product-ad orbit shot.
cases.promptFull: A single sneaker on a rotating pedestal in a seamless white studio, 360-degree orbit camera move, shifting rim light from cool to warm across the rotation, soft product-ad shadows, subtle dust particles catching the key light, commercial grade sharpness.
cases.creator: render_studio_kai

cases.promptFull: Selfie-style talk-to-camera shot, handheld phone framing, natural morning window light, creator narrates a morning routine with dialogue synced to the audio track, slight jitter and occasional reframing typical of authentic UGC, casual bedroom background.

cases.title: Mountain Ridge Timelapse
cases.summary: Clouds pour over a mountain ridge in a sweeping timelapse as light shifts from dusk to full night.
cases.promptFull: Wide landscape shot of a mountain ridge, clouds pouring over the rock face in fast timelapse motion, light shifting gradually from dusk orange to deep blue night, stars beginning to emerge, slow parallax push-in on the peak.
cases.creator: highaltitude_films

cases.title: Macro Plating Close-Up
cases.summary: A chef's hands plate a dessert in extreme macro detail with sauce drizzled in a slow, deliberate arc.
cases.promptFull: Extreme macro close-up of a chef's hands plating a dessert, sauce drizzled in a slow deliberate arc across white ceramic, shallow focus racking from spoon to plate, warm kitchen light, steam wisps in the background, food-commercial texture detail.

cases.title: Rooftop Drone Reveal
cases.summary: A drone rises from street level to reveal a neon-lit rooftop party in one continuous unbroken shot.
cases.promptFull: Drone shot starting at street level between two buildings, rising smoothly and continuously to reveal a rooftop party lit by neon signage and string lights, camera pitching forward as it clears the roofline, guests dancing, city skyline glowing in the background at dusk.

cases.title: Desert Convoy Dust Trail

cases.promptFull: Wide tracking shot of an off-road vehicle convoy crossing an open desert at golden hour, long dust trails kicked up behind each vehicle, warm low-angle sunlight, heat shimmer on the horizon, camera holding a steady parallel track alongside the convoy.
